summary.name: MidReal
summary.one_liner: MidReal was an AI story generator that turned a single sentence into a long-form novel or story, and the page now announces that the product is being sunset.
use_cases: generate a novel from a single sentence
summary.what_it_does: The page describes MidReal as a tool for creating novels and stories from a single sentence, with no prompt needed, unlimited memory and infinite length, according to its meta description. It also offered a section for reading other users' stories. The page text, however, is now a sunset notice saying MidReal is being discontinued as the company shifts focus. It points former users to Macaron, described as a personal AI that builds customized mini-apps and life tools from a sentence. Former MidReal users can email their Macaron ID to contact@macaron.im to receive additional almonds.
notable: Sentence-to-story generation with no prompt needed, per the meta description
Shut down; the company points users to Macaron as its successor
Former users can email their Macaron ID to contact@macaron.im for additional almonds
caveats: MidReal is being sunset and the page no longer offers the story generator
Pricing is listed as free only in the title and meta description; the sunset notice does not restate it
